title: 中学一年级
description: 适合12-13岁孩子，原版章节书阅读、TED演讲理解、新闻纪录片深度观看
descriptionEn: For children aged 12-13. Original chapter book reading, TED talk comprehension, deep news documentary watching.

items.description: 精选适合青少年的TED演讲，涵盖成长、科技、环保、社会议题，锻炼听力+观点理解。
items.descriptionEn: Curated TED talks for teens covering growth, technology, environment, and social issues. Exercises listening and opinion comprehension.
items.url: Search: 'TED Talks for teens 英文'

items.description: 快速讲解科学、工程、历史等学科核心概念，语速稍快但逻辑清晰，适合中学预备。
items.descriptionEn: Quick explanations of core concepts in science, engineering, and history. Slightly fast but clear logic, great for secondary prep.

items.englishName: The Boy Who Harnessed the Wind
items.description: 马拉维男孩用废料造风车发电的真实故事改编，非洲英语口音+励志主题。
items.descriptionEn: Based on the true story of a Malawian boy who built a windmill from scrap. African English accent plus inspirational theme.
items.url: Search: 'The Boy Who Harnessed the Wind 英文版'

items.description: 科学实验+街头采访+动画，讲解睡眠、社交媒体、食物等青少年关心的话题。
items.descriptionEn: Science experiments, street interviews, and animation explaining topics teens care about: sleep, social media, food.

items.description: BBC儿童新闻每日更新，时事+科技+娱乐，培养新闻英语阅读习惯。
items.descriptionEn: BBC children's news daily updates. Current events, tech, and entertainment. Builds news English reading habits.

items.description: 亚裔女孩帮同学写情书却发现自己也喜欢对方的青春故事，美式校园对话+情感表达。
items.descriptionEn: An Asian-American girl helps a classmate write love letters but discovers her own feelings. American school dialogue plus emotional expression.
items.url: Search: 'The Half of It 英文版'

items.description: BBC最长寿的儿童节目，手工制作、挑战任务、动物嘉宾应有尽有，地道英式英语。
items.descriptionEn: BBC's longest-running children's show. Crafts, challenge tasks, animal guests. Authentic British English.

items.description: BBC儿童新闻节目，用孩子能懂的语言讲时事，新闻英语+全球视野。
items.descriptionEn: BBC children's news program. Current events explained in kid-friendly language. News English plus global perspective.

items.description: 双胞胎医生兄弟用实验和医院实拍讲解人体知识，医学词汇丰富但讲解有趣不吓人。
items.descriptionEn: Twin doctor brothers explain human body knowledge through experiments and hospital footage. Rich medical vocabulary, fun and not scary.
